JARA TAFSEEER SE BATAYE Narrated with sound chains from Dhu Mikhbar al-Najashi: " You will make a firm truce with the Romans (al-Rum) until you and they wage a campaign against an enemy that is attacking them. You will be granted victory and great spoils. Then you will alight in a plain surrounded by hills. There, someone among the Romans shall say: 'The Cross has overcome!' whereupon someone among the Muslims shall say: 'Nay, Allah has overcome!' and shall go and break the cross. The Romans shall kill him, then the Muslims shall take up their arms and the two sides shall fall upon each other. Allah shall grant martyrdom to that group of Muslims. After that the Romans shall say to their leader: 'We shall relieve you of the Arabs,' and they shall gather up for the great battle. They shall come to you under eighty flags (nations), each flag (nation) gathering 12,000 troops." (Abu Dawud, Kitab al-Jihad - Vol. 3/7 - No. 2479, Ahmad, Ibn Majah) 2789 views Q. answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> Hadith & Sunnah Question ID: 8380 Country: OM Title: Aslam o alaikum i wanted to confirm tht is thr any hadith regarding a student tht if student does nt avoids sins during his study period thn he wil b punished in 3 ways,one is tht he wil die in his study peroid before completing it. Or anythng similar to it like this Question: Aslam o alaikum i wanted to confirm tht is thr any hadith regarding a student tht if student does nt avoids sins during his study period thn he wil b punished in 3 ways,one is tht he wil die in his study peroid before completing it. Or anythng similar to it like this Answer ID: 8380 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2224/1716=H/1429) Yes, some scholars have narrated this Hadith that such a person who does not avoid sins as student and does not adopt piety he will face any of three things: (a) either he will die at a young age (b) or Allah will let him in any unpopulated place (c) or he shall be in service of any ruler. (Talimul Mutallim: 115) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
